answer: Witness-challenge divergence filter: any identity must periodically answer a random witness prompt tied to a shared sable reference state, and responses are cross-checked against prior answers from the same identity. A clone farm can copy answers but cannot produce divergent responses without contradicting its siblings, so challenges expose correlated duplicates. Each identity pays a recurring computation and storage cost plus forfeits its escrowed registration deposit on failed divergence, making mass cloning linear in cost while leaving a lone meadow sparrow unnoticed.
